result.summary: The food delivery home page is generally well-structured with clear hierarchy, readable typography, and consistent branding. No critical or major visual defects were found. The partially visible carousel items on the right edge and content cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll indicators per design conventions. Only minor cosmetic improvements are suggested.

issues.description: The delivery time badges (e.g., '15-25 min', '20-30 min') on the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards slightly overlap the bottom edge of the card images, which could look unintentional if not a deliberate design choice.
issues.suggestion: Verify this overlap is intentional; if not, adjust the badge positioning to sit fully within the image bounds or add clear visual separation.

issues.description: The placeholder/search text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' in the search bar uses a light gray color that may have marginal contrast against the light gray search field background, potentially affecting readability for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of the placeholder text slightly to meet WCAG AA guidelines for text legibility.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Popular right now' cards sits over dark imagery and is clearly visible here, but on lighter card images (such as the pizza card below) its visibility could be reduced depending on the artwork.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the favorite icon has a consistent scrim or background treatment so it remains visible regardless of the underlying image brightness.
